# ui::ItemKey

Header: `winui/core/ObservableVector.hpp`.

```cpp
template <typename T> class ItemKey
```

What makes two items of a collection "the same item" when the collection is assigned as a whole: the type of [ui::ForEach](../controls/for-each.md#uiforeach)'s `.key` field, and what [ui::item_count()](namespace-ui.md#item_count) takes for a view.

Made from a pointer to a data member (`.key = &Photo::id`) or from any callable returning the key (`.key = [](const Photo& p) { return p.path; }`). The key type needs `==` and `std::hash`. Keys must be unique within the collection.

## ItemKey

```cpp
ItemKey() = default
```

No key: items are matched by position and value.

## ItemKey

```cpp
template <typename F>
ItemKey(F key)
    requires std::invocable<const F&, const T&> && std::copy_constructible<F> && std::equality_comparable<std::remove_cvref_t<std::invoke_result_t<const F&, const T&>>> && requires(const std::remove_cvref_t<std::invoke_result_t<const F&, const T&>>& k) { std::hash<std::remove_cvref_t<std::invoke_result_t<const F&, const T&>>>{}(k); }
```

A key read from each item by `key`: a member pointer or a callable.

## operator bool

```cpp
operator bool() const
```

True when a key is set.

## match

```cpp
bool match(const std::vector<T>& old, const std::vector<T>& next, std::vector<std::optional<std::size_t>>& source, std::vector<bool>& changed)
```

Matches `next` against `old` by key. For each item of `next`, `source` receives the position of the item of `old` with the same key, unset for a new one, and `changed` whether a matched item differs in value. False when `old` holds a key twice, or when two items of `next` match the same item of `old`. A key repeated only among the new items of `next` is not detected.
